newsitem.title: FRANCE: Italian film icon Mastroianni dies in France.
newsitem.headline: Italian film icon Mastroianni dies in France.

text.p: Veteran Italian film star Marcello Mastroianni died at his home in Paris on Thursday, a French cinema producer said. He was 73.
"He was perhaps the greatest European cinema actor of the last 50 years," producer Daniel Toscan du Plantier said.

French media said Mastroianni, a familiar figure in the streets and restaurants of Paris' Left Bank, had been treated for cancer of the pancreas for several months, but he continued to make films until his last months.
He appeared at the Cannes film festival last May to present "Trois Vies et une seule Mort" (Three Lives and only one Death).
Radio stations said Mastroianni's companion, French actress Catherine Deneuve, their daughter, actress Chiara Mastroianni, and actor Michel Piccoli were at his side when he died.
"He reminds us of Fellini and of all the great things that made post-war Italian cinema, which is also dead," Toscan du Plantier told LCI television.
